tasks.label: Setup Project
tasks.detail: Create .venv when needed and install the editable development environment.

args: if [ ! -d .venv ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; fi; ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip; ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
if [ ! -d .venv ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; fi; ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip; ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
if (-not (Test-Path .venv)) { python -m venv .venv }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

tasks.label: Run Tests
tasks.detail: Run the pytest suite with the local virtual environment.

tasks.label: Build Docs
tasks.detail: Regenerate example docs and build the Sphinx site locally.

args: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\generate_example_docs.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m sphinx -b html docs docs\_build\html -n -W --keep-going -E
